system.description:
Lore: Fabled Relic Wand (Bound)

A skull-topped rod of the Demon Prince of Undeath. The one in the White Wyrm's hoard is a replica - though nothing about holding it feels like a replica. It has the following Powers:

  • (+3) Weapon: Deals an extra +3 damage.
  • Soul Eater: Those killed by it can't be resurrected unless a wish is granted to do so.
  • Vicious: On a Crit, the Target takes extra damage equal to twice its HD.
  • Bane of the Living: Deals an extra damage die to the living; Undead who see it must pass [Will] or serve the wielder.
  • Doom: The wielder only regains 1 HP per die rolled to heal them, and Undead everywhere become aware of where the wand is.

Value: 85000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
